description: The plot illustrates the impact of hyperparameter N on AUC, with the x-axis labeled "N", having a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "AUC", has a linear scale, and ranges from 0.5 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are five lines in the plot, each representing a different dataset: SMD (orange, square marker, solid line), PSM (blue, circle marker, solid line), SWaT (red, star marker, solid line), SMAP (green, diamond marker, solid line), and MSI (purple, triangle marker, solid line). The lines generally increase as N increases from 1 to 20, with the SMD line starting at approximately 0.83 and ending at 0.93, the PSM line starting at around 0.86 and ending at 0.93, the SWaT line starting at about 0.83 and ending at 0.93, the SMAP line starting at roughly 0.86 and ending at 0.93, and the MSI line starting at approximately 0.83 and ending at 0.93.
